setup.command: apt-get update >/dev/null 2>&1 && apt-get install -y git-lfs >/dev/null 2>&1 && mise install rust@1.97.1 >/dev/null 2>&1; RUST_BIN="$HOME/.local/share/mise/installs/rust/1.97.1"; for b in cargo rustc rustup rustfmt cargo-clippy clippy-driver rust-analyzer; do ln -sf "$RUST_BIN/$b" /usr/local/bin/$b; done; hash -r; rustc --version && git lfs version
